title: possibilizing
description: The modal diamond operation of the valuation: it raises each cell's charge to the knowledge-join of the charges assigned at that cell across the fiber-algebras and appends the result as a new knowledge-monotone valuation on the trace. Inflationary, left adjoint of necessitating's box.

morphism.description: a one-way generative arrow; moves each charge up the knowledge order to the knowledge-join across the fiber-algebras, appending a new valuation to the trace

domain.description: the valuation it maps out of - the charge assignment over the trace

codomain.description: the new knowledge-monotone valuation appended to the trace
